name: Code Change Unit Test A2A Flow

agents.name: Change Detector
agents.responsibility: Detect changed files and classify them as frontend, backend, both, or ignored.

agents.name: Frontend Test Writer
agents.responsibility: Write or update Angular unit tests for changed frontend code.

agents.name: Backend Test Writer
agents.responsibility: Write or update Spring Boot unit tests for changed backend code.

agents.name: Unit Test Runner
agents.responsibility: Run the relevant frontend and/or backend unit tests and publish results.
